retired_clause_text: This Standard applies to any third-party processor acting on the Company's behalf, including processors engaged under a trial or pilot agreement.
current_clause_text: 3.1 This Standard applies to all employees, contractors, and temporary staff of Halbrook Analytics who create, receive, store, transmit, or otherwise process Company Data on any system owned, leased, or administered by the Company. 3.2 This Standard also applies to any third-party processor acting on the Company's behalf, including processors engaged under a trial, pilot, or evaluation agreement, and to any system that synchronizes Company Data with an external service. 3.3 Where an acquired legal entity maintains a substantially equivalent standard, the Chief Information Security Officer may grant a documented equivalence exception for a period not exceeding twelve (12) months.

retired_clause_text: Encryption at rest using AES-256 is required for all Confidential data stores.
current_clause_text: 13.1 All Company Data classified as Confidential or Restricted must be encrypted at rest on production systems, portable media, and backup archives. 13.2 Encryption must use AES-256 in Galois/Counter Mode (AES-256-GCM) or an algorithm of equivalent strength approved by the Security Architecture Board, and data encryption keys must be rotated at intervals not exceeding one hundred eighty (180) days. 13.3 Where hardware security modules are used, key material must be generated within the module and must not be exportable in plaintext. 13.4 Exceptions to this clause require written approval from the Chief Information Security Officer and a compensating control recorded in the risk register.

retired_clause_text: Backups of Restricted data must be retained for a minimum of thirty-five (35) days.
current_clause_text: 17.1 Backups of Restricted data must be retained for a minimum of sixty (60) calendar days. 17.2 A representative backup restore test must be performed at least once each quarter, and the results recorded in the resilience log. 17.3 Backup media that leave a Company-controlled facility must be encrypted in accordance with Clause 13 and transported by a supplier approved under the Third-Party Risk Standard.

retired_clause_text: The Privacy Office must acknowledge a data subject request within ten (10) business days of receipt and fulfil it within thirty (30) calendar days of receipt.
current_clause_text: 19.1 The Privacy Office must acknowledge every verifiable data subject request within five (5) business days of receipt. 19.2 If a request is manifestly unfounded or excessive, the Privacy Office must record the reason for refusal and notify the requester within ten (10) business days.

retired_clause_text: The Privacy Office must acknowledge a data subject request within ten (10) business days of receipt and fulfil it within thirty (30) calendar days of receipt.
current_clause_text: 20.1 A verifiable data subject request must be fulfilled within thirty (30) calendar days of acknowledgement. 20.2 Where a request is complex, the fulfilment period may be extended by up to a further thirty (30) calendar days, provided the requester is informed of the extension before the original period expires. 20.3 Fulfilment records must be retained for three (3) years after closure.

retired_clause_text: Access to privileged accounts is restricted to personnel who hold a current Privileged Access Authorisation issued by the local IT manager.
current_clause_text: 22.1 Access to privileged accounts on production systems is restricted to personnel who hold a current Privileged Access Authorisation issued by the Head of Infrastructure Security. 22.2 Privileged sessions must be recorded and the recordings retained for at least ninety (90) days. 22.3 Shared privileged credentials are prohibited; each privileged account must be attributable to a single named individual.
